name: tokio
description: Refine coding requests into concise, implementation-ready prompts locally.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Prompt refinement remains available, but repository context scanning is disabled until the workspace is trusted.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/core/category.test.js out/core/refine.test.js out/core/analysis.test.js out/context/discovery.test.js out/context/project.test.js out/ui/messages.test.js out/ui/security.test.js out/tsconfig.test.js out/broker/audit.test.js out/broker/activity.test.js out/broker/bench.test.js out/broker/scan.test.js out/context/repomap.test.js out/context/imports.test.js out/context/history.test.js out/broker/policy.test.js out/broker/hook.test.js out/broker/prompt-hook.test.js out/broker/init.test.js out/broker/tools.test.js out/broker/mcp.test.js out/broker/stats.test.js out/broker/route.test.js out/context/routing.test.js out/broker/doctor.test.js out/broker/catalog.test.js out/broker/repos.test.js out/context/packages.test.js out/broker/scope.test.js out/broker/repo-audit.test.js out/ui/repos.test.js out/broker/links.test.js out/context/php.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:package
